source: A model can fit entirely in device memory and still run slowly because kernels repeatedly move large amounts of data through the ZXNAME0000XZ interface. Conversely, a kernel may have a small memory footprint yet be latency-sensitive because its accesses are sparse or dependent.
zh: 模型可以完全适合设备内存，但仍然运行缓慢，因为内核通过 ZXNAME0000XZ 接口反复移动大量数据。相反，内核可能具有较小的内存占用，但对延迟敏感，因为它的访问是稀疏的或相关的。
